issues.title: Final dispatch authorizes caller-declared side-effect class instead of actual typed-plan side effect
issues.resolution: The final dispatcher derives the actual side-effect class from the typed plan, rejects declared/actual mismatches, and authorizes only against the derived class.

issues.title: State-changing prepared actions can bypass authorization when query semantics are absent
issues.resolution: The former state-changing no-semantics compatibility exemption was removed; absent semantics now block before dispatch with missing_request_semantics.
